title: SUMX with a context transition over duplicated rows counts each group once per copy
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", SUMX ( Dup, CALCULATE ( SUM ( Dup[Value] ) ) ) )

source.quote: if you use context transition in a table that contains duplicated rows, the filter context generated by CALCULATE includes all the duplicates
source.supports: each duplicated row's filter context includes all the duplicates

derivation: Per row the transition gives: A 20, A 20, B 5, C 3, C 3, C 3. Sum 20 + 20 + 5 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 54. The plain SUM ( Dup[Value] ) is 28.
notes: Type: the sum is taken to have the type of the summed expression, an integer.
